digest.component_or_area: Jira Cloud/DataCenter adapter — user identity model
propositions: Cloud identifies users by opaque accountId; DataCenter identifies users by name, requiring different resolution contracts and payload shapes.

PR #120 hardcoded is_account_id=False for DC and consulted an unset _assignee_resolver attribute, rendering the authoritative branch unreachable and causing permanent non-authoritative resolution that produces assignee-diff churn.

A UserIdentityModel protocol with resolve(local_value, remote_identity) and to_payload(value) abstractions, implemented by AccountIdIdentity and NameIdentity, fixes the contract and allows DC's resolver to perform real lookups and return authoritative=True.
NameIdentity performs stateful user-search lookups against the DC endpoint to achieve authoritative resolution, eliminating the churn class that epic ace2 was created to address.
An unresolvable assignee must raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError rather than silently returning non-authoritative values.
